source.text: סְבָבֻ֤נִי בְכַ֨חַשׁ֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וּבְמִרְמָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה עֹ֥ד רָד֙ עִם־אֵ֔ל וְעִם־קְדוֹשִׁ֖ים נֶאֱמָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Have surrounded me with lying Ephraim, and with deceit [the] house of Israel; and Judah still roams with God, and with [the] Holy One [is] faithful.

en.L: Ephraim has surrounded {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with lies, \q and the house of Israel with deceit; \q and Judah still roams wild against God, \q against the Holy One, [who is] faithful.
en.B: Ephraim has surrounded {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with lies, \q the house of Israel with deceit, \q and Judah still runs wild against God, \q against the faithful Holy One.
en.R: Ephraim surrounds {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with lies. \q The people of Israel deceive {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on every side. \q And Judah still runs wild and turns against God, \q against the Holy One, who is faithful.

es.L: Efraín {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha rodeado de mentira, \q y la casa de Israel de engaño; \q y Judá todavía se desboca contra Dios, \q contra el Santo, [que es] fiel.
es.B: Efraín {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha rodeado de mentiras, \q la casa de Israel de engaño, \q y Judá sigue desbocado contra Dios, \q contra el Santo, que es fiel.
es.R: Efraín {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rodea de mentiras. \q El pueblo de Israel {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} engaña por todas partes. \q Y Judá sigue desbocado y se vuelve contra Dios, \q contra el Santo, que es fiel.

fr.L: Éphraïm {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a entouré de mensonge, \q et la maison d’Israël de tromperie ; \q et Juda se déchaîne encore contre Dieu, \q contre le Saint, [qui est] fidèle.
fr.B: Éphraïm {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a entouré de mensonges, \q la maison d’Israël de tromperie, \q et Juda se déchaîne encore contre Dieu, \q contre le Saint qui est fidèle.
fr.R: Éphraïm {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}entoure de mensonges. \q Le peuple d’Israël {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trompe de tous côtés. \q Et Juda se déchaîne encore et se dresse contre Dieu, \q contre le Saint, qui est fidèle.

sw.L: Efraimu amenizunguka kwa uongo, \q na nyumba ya Israeli kwa hila; \q na Yuda bado anatangatanga kwa ukaidi dhidi ya Mungu, \q dhidi ya Mtakatifu, [aliye] mwaminifu.
sw.B: Efraimu amenizunguka kwa uongo, \q nyumba ya Israeli kwa udanganyifu, \q na Yuda bado anajiendea kwa ukaidi dhidi ya Mungu, \q dhidi ya Mtakatifu aliye mwaminifu.
sw.R: Efraimu ananizunguka kwa uongo. \q Watu wa Israeli wananidanganya kila upande. \q Na Yuda bado anajiendea kiholela na kumpinga Mungu, \q yaani Mtakatifu, aliye mwaminifu.

vi.L: Ép-ra-im đã vây quanh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng sự dối trá, \q và nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên bằng sự lừa gạt; \q còn Giu-đa vẫn buông tuồng chống lại Đức Chúa Trời, \q chống lại Đấng Thánh, [Đấng] thành tín.
vi.B: Ép-ra-im đã vây quanh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những lời dối trá, \q nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên bằng sự lừa gạt, \q còn Giu-đa vẫn buông tuồng chống lại Đức Chúa Trời, \q chống lại Đấng Thánh thành tín.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im vây quanh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những lời dối trá. \q Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lừa dối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khắp mọi bề. \q Còn Giu-đa vẫn buông tuồng và quay lưng chống lại Đức Chúa Trời, \q chống lại Đấng Thánh, Đấng thành tín.

ko.L: 에브라임이 거짓으로 나를 에워쌌고, \q 이스라엘 집이 속임수로 [나를 에워쌌다]. \q 유다는 아직도 하나님을 거슬러 제멋대로 다니고, \q 신실한 거룩한 분을 거슬러 [다닌다].
ko.B: 에브라임은 거짓말로 나를 에워쌌고, \q 이스라엘 집은 속임수로 나를 에워쌌다. \q 유다도 여전히 하나님을 거슬러 날뛰고, \q 신실한 거룩한 분을 거슬러 날뛴다.
ko.R: 에브라임은 거짓말로 나를 에워싼다. \q 이스라엘 백성은 사방에서 나를 속인다. \q 유다도 여전히 제멋대로 날뛰며 하나님께 맞선다. \q 신실한 거룩한 분께 맞선다.

decisions.choice: This verse is 12:1 in the Hebrew text, 11:12 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text closes chapter 11 with "declares the LORD" and a section break (11:11), and begins chapter 12 here. Many Bibles number this verse 11:12, so their 12:1-14 is 12:2-15 here. Open Word Bible follows the numbering of the Hebrew text it translates. The verse opens the charge of lies and deceit that runs through chapter 12.

decisions.choice: Judah still runs wild against God: Judah too is unfaithful
alternatives: Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One (Judah set in contrast with Ephraim)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this half of the verse is very uncertain. The verb is rare; in Jeremiah 2:31 it describes a people who say "we roam free; we will come to you no more". Read that way, the line joins Judah to Ephraim's guilt, and 12:3 goes on to bring a charge against Judah. But the words "with God" and "faithful" can also be read as praise of Judah, in contrast with Ephraim, as 4:15 hopes Judah will not share Israel's guilt. The first reading is followed.

decisions.choice: the Holy One: a plural form used for God
alternatives: the holy ones (angels or the gods)
decisions.reason: The word is plural, as it is when it names God in Proverbs 9:10 and 30:3. Set beside "God", it names the Holy One of 11:9.

decisions.choice: lies and deceit: false dealing with God and with others
decisions.reason: Lies are what Ephraim offers God in place of faithfulness (7:3, 13; 10:13). "Deceit" returns in 12:8, in the "scales of deceit" of the trader, and is the theme the chapter follows into the story of Jacob.

decisions.choice: roams wild against (L); runs wild against (B, R)
decisions.reason: The small word usually means "with"; with this verb it is taken as "against" (m2). God is the speaker in the first half, so "me" takes the deity pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: The people of Israel deceive me on every side (R)
alternatives: the house of Israel with deceit
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Israel" for "the house of Israel" and makes the second line a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "se desboca contra Dios" (L); "sigue desbocado contra Dios" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures an animal running loose; Spanish "desbocarse" keeps that picture, as the English "roams wild" / "runs wild".

decisions.choice: "신실한 거룩한 분" without the honorific -시-
decisions.reason: The LORD himself is speaking in this verse, and God takes no honorific in his own mouth; the English gives "the Holy One" no pronoun setting.

source.text: אֶפְרַ֜יִם רֹעֶ֥ה ר֨וּחַ֙ וְרֹדֵ֣ף קָדִ֔ים כָּל־הַיּ֕וֹם כָּזָ֥ב וָשֹׁ֖ד יַרְבֶּ֑ה וּבְרִית֙ עִם־אַשּׁ֣וּר יִכְרֹ֔תוּ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לְמִצְרַ֥יִם יוּבָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Ephraim herds wind and pursues [the] east wind; all the day lying and violence he multiplies; and a covenant with Assyria they make, and oil to Egypt is carried.

en.L: Ephraim herds the wind and chases the east wind; \q all day long he multiplies lies and violence; \q and they make a covenant with Assyria, \q and oil is carried to Egypt.
en.B: Ephraim tends the wind like a flock and chases the east wind; \q all day long he piles up lies and violence. \q They make a treaty with Assyria \q and send olive oil to Egypt.
en.R: Ephraim tries to herd the wind and chases the scorching east wind. \q All day long he adds lie to lie and violence to violence. \q His people make a treaty with Assyria \q and send olive oil to Egypt as a gift.

es.L: Efraín apacienta viento y persigue el viento del este; \q todo el día multiplica la mentira y la violencia; \q y hacen pacto con Asiria, \q y el aceite es llevado a Egipto.
es.B: Efraín cuida el viento como si fuera un rebaño y persigue el viento del este; \q todo el día amontona mentiras y violencia. \q Hacen alianza con Asiria \q y envían aceite de oliva a Egipto.
es.R: Efraín intenta pastorear el viento y persigue el abrasador viento del este. \q Todo el día añade mentira a mentira y violencia a violencia. \q Su pueblo hace alianza con Asiria \q y envía aceite de oliva a Egipto como regalo.

fr.L: Éphraïm fait paître le vent et poursuit le vent d’est ; \q tout le jour il multiplie le mensonge et la violence ; \q et ils concluent une alliance avec l’Assyrie, \q et l’huile est portée en Égypte.
fr.B: Éphraïm garde le vent comme un troupeau et court après le vent d’est ; \q tout le jour il accumule mensonges et violence. \q Ils concluent un traité avec l’Assyrie \q et envoient de l’huile d’olive en Égypte.
fr.R: Éphraïm essaie de mener le vent comme un troupeau et court après le vent brûlant de l’est. \q Toute la journée, il ajoute mensonge sur mensonge et violence sur violence. \q Son peuple conclut un traité avec l’Assyrie \q et envoie de l’huile d’olive en cadeau à l’Égypte.

sw.L: Efraimu anachunga upepo na kuufuata upepo wa mashariki; \q mchana kutwa anaongeza uongo na ukatili; \q nao wanafanya agano na Ashuru, \q na mafuta yanapelekwa Misri.
sw.B: Efraimu anauchunga upepo kama kundi la mifugo na kuufukuza upepo wa mashariki; \q mchana kutwa analimbikiza uongo na ukatili. \q Wanafanya mkataba na Ashuru \q na kupeleka mafuta ya zeituni Misri.
sw.R: Efraimu anajaribu kuuchunga upepo na kuufukuza upepo wa mashariki unaounguza. \q Mchana kutwa anaongeza uongo juu ya uongo na ukatili juu ya ukatili. \q Watu wake wanafanya mkataba na Ashuru \q na kupeleka mafuta ya zeituni Misri kama zawadi.

vi.L: Ép-ra-im chăn gió và đuổi theo gió đông; \q suốt ngày nó gia tăng sự dối trá và bạo lực; \q chúng lập giao ước với A-si-ri, \q và dầu được chở sang Ai Cập.
vi.B: Ép-ra-im chăn gió như chăn bầy và đuổi theo gió đông; \q suốt ngày nó chồng chất dối trá và bạo lực. \q Chúng lập hiệp ước với A-si-ri \q và gửi dầu ô-liu sang Ai Cập.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im cố chăn gió và đuổi theo ngọn gió đông nóng bỏng. \q Suốt ngày nó thêm dối trá chồng lên dối trá, bạo lực chồng lên bạo lực. \q Dân của nó lập hiệp ước với A-si-ri \q và gửi dầu ô-liu làm quà sang Ai Cập.

ko.L: 에브라임은 바람을 먹이며 동풍을 뒤쫓는다. \q 온종일 거짓과 폭력을 더한다. \q 그들은 앗시리아와 언약을 맺고, \q 기름은 이집트로 실려 간다.
ko.B: 에브라임은 바람을 양 떼처럼 치고 동풍을 쫓아다닌다. \q 온종일 거짓과 폭력을 쌓는다. \q 그들은 앗시리아와 조약을 맺고 \q 올리브기름을 이집트로 보낸다.
ko.R: 에브라임은 바람을 몰고 다니려 하고, 뜨거운 동풍을 쫓아다닌다. \q 온종일 거짓에 거짓을, 폭력에 폭력을 더한다. \q 그 백성은 앗시리아와 조약을 맺고 \q 올리브기름을 이집트에 선물로 보낸다.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: Hebrew 12:2-15 is 12:1-14 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text chapter 12 begins with "Ephraim has surrounded me with lies", which many Bibles number 11:12, and so this verse and the rest of the chapter (12:2-15 here) are numbered 12:1-14 there. The words are the same; only the numbers differ. Hosea is cited by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: herds the wind, chases the east wind: pursuing what is empty and does harm
decisions.reason: The verb means to shepherd or to graze, so Ephraim either tends the wind like a flock or feeds on it; both say that its efforts are empty (8:7, "they sow the wind"). The east wind is the hot, dry wind from the desert that withers the land (13:15; Genesis 41:6). Ephraim runs after the very thing that will ruin it.

decisions.choice: a covenant with Assyria, oil to Egypt: seeking safety from both great powers
decisions.reason: Israel's kings bargained with Assyria and Egypt by turns (7:11). King Hoshea paid tribute to Assyria and then sent to So, king of Egypt, for help (2 Kings 17:3-4). Olive oil was one of the land's chief goods and a fitting gift to seal an agreement (compare 1 Kings 5:25). The people put their trust in treaties rather than in God.

decisions.choice: send olive oil (B, R); as a gift (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the sentence active and say that the oil is olive oil. Readable adds "as a gift" to say why it is carried (m3).

decisions.choice: tends the wind like a flock (B); tries to herd the wind (R); adds lie to lie (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the picture of herding plain (m2). Readable says "multiplies" as adding one lie to another, and "scorching" for the east wind.

source.text: וְרִ֥יב לַֽיהוָ֖ה עִם־יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלִפְקֹ֤ד עַֽל־יַעֲקֹב֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו כְּמַעֲלָלָ֖יו יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And a case [belongs] to Yahweh with Judah, and to punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has a case against Judah, \q and [he will] bring Jacob to account according to his ways; \q according to his deeds {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will return [it] to him.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has a case to bring against Judah; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will punish Jacob for his ways \q and repay him for what he has done.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is bringing charges against Judah. \q He will punish Jacob for the way he has lived. \q He will pay him back for what he has done.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene un pleito con Judá, \q y [pedirá] cuentas a Jacob conforme a sus caminos; \q conforme a sus obras le pagará.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene una acusación contra Judá; \q castigará a Jacob por sus caminos \q y le pagará por sus obras.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} presenta cargos contra Judá. \q Castigará a Jacob por su manera de vivir. \q Le dará lo que merece por lo que ha hecho.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a un procès avec Juda, \q et [il va] punir Jacob selon ses voies ; \q selon ses actions {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [les] lui rendra.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a une accusation à porter contre Juda ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} punira Jacob pour sa conduite \q et lui rendra selon ses actes.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} porte plainte contre Juda. \q Il punira Jacob pour sa manière de vivre. \q Il lui fera payer ce qu’il a fait.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana mashtaka dhidi ya Yuda, \q na [atamwadhibu] Yakobo kwa njia zake; \q kwa matendo yake atamlipa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana mashtaka dhidi ya Yuda; \q atamwadhibu Yakobo kwa njia zake \q na kumlipa kwa matendo yake.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anamshtaki Yuda. \q Atamwadhibu Yakobo kwa jinsi alivyoishi. \q Atamlipa kwa yale aliyoyatenda.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có một vụ kiện với Giu-đa, \q và [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ] thăm phạt Gia-cốp theo đường lối nó; \q theo việc làm của nó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ báo trả cho nó.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có lời buộc tội Giu-đa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ trừng phạt Gia-cốp về đường lối nó \q và báo trả nó về việc làm của nó.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang buộc tội Giu-đa. \q Ngài sẽ trừng phạt Gia-cốp vì lối sống của nó. \q Ngài sẽ báo trả nó về những điều nó đã làm.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다와 다투실 일이 있으니, \q 야곱을 그의 행실대로 벌하시고, \q 그의 행위대로 그에게 갚으실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다를 고소하신다. \q 야곱을 그의 행실대로 벌하시고, \q 그가 한 일대로 갚으실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다를 재판에 걸고 계신다. \q 그분께서 야곱을 그가 살아온 대로 벌하시고, \q 그가 한 대로 갚아 주실 것이다.

decisions.choice: a case: a legal charge brought as in a court
decisions.reason: The word is the one used in 4:1, where the LORD has a case against the people of the land. God is the one who brings the charge and also the judge who will give sentence.

decisions.choice: Judah ... Jacob: the people named after their ancestor
decisions.reason: Jacob here is the people descended from him, standing beside Judah as in 10:11. The name leads straight into the story of Jacob himself (verses 4-5 and 13), set beside the conduct of the nation that bears his name.

decisions.choice: punish according to his ways, repay according to his deeds: the sentence of 4:9
decisions.reason: In 4:9 God says, "I will punish them for their ways and repay them for their deeds." The same words return here. To "punish" is literally to "visit" someone's ways upon him: to call them to account.

decisions.choice: [he will] bring Jacob to account (L); he will punish (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "and to punish", an infinitive that continues the case: the LORD will bring the charge and punish. Literal brackets the words English needs, and says "bring to account" for the verb "visit" (m3). For the last verb, "he will return to him", Literal keeps "return [it] to him"; Balanced and Readable say "repay" and "pay back".

decisions.choice: the wording of 4:9 at each level
decisions.reason: The sentence repeats 4:9, so each level keeps the words used there ("pedir cuentas" or "castigar", "pagar").

decisions.choice: "punir ... selon ses voies ... rendra" (L), "punira ... pour sa conduite" (B), "pour sa manière de vivre ... fera payer" (R), as Hosea 4:9
decisions.reason: The two last lines repeat the words of 4:9, so each level reuses the French drafted there, in the third person.

decisions.choice: the words of 4:9 at each level ("행실대로 벌하시고 ... 행위대로 갚으실"), with -시- because the prophet speaks of God
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 4:9, where God speaks; here Hosea speaks about the LORD, so the same words take the honorific.

source.text: בַּבֶּ֖טֶן עָקַ֣ב אֶת־אָחִ֑יו וּבְאוֹנ֖וֹ שָׂרָ֥ה אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: In the womb he took by the heel his brother, and in his vigor he strove with God.

en.L: In the womb he grasped his brother's heel, \q and in his strength he strove with God.
en.B: In the womb he grabbed his brother by the heel, \q and in his full strength he contended with God.
en.R: Even before Jacob was born, he grabbed his brother's heel. \q As a strong man, he struggled with God.

es.L: En el vientre tomó a su hermano por el talón, \q y en su vigor luchó con Dios.
es.B: En el vientre agarró a su hermano por el talón, \q y en la plenitud de su fuerza luchó contra Dios.
es.R: Antes de que Jacob naciera, agarró el talón de su hermano. \q Cuando ya era un hombre fuerte, luchó con Dios.

fr.L: Dans le ventre il a saisi le talon de son frère, \q et dans sa vigueur il a lutté avec Dieu.
fr.B: Dans le ventre de sa mère, il a attrapé son frère par le talon, \q et dans la force de l’âge il a combattu avec Dieu.
fr.R: Avant même de naître, Jacob a attrapé le talon de son frère. \q Devenu un homme fort, il a lutté avec Dieu.

sw.L: Tumboni alimshika ndugu yake kisigino, \q na katika nguvu zake alishindana na Mungu.
sw.B: Akiwa tumboni alimshika ndugu yake kisigino, \q na katika nguvu zake kamili alipambana na Mungu.
sw.R: Hata kabla Yakobo hajazaliwa, alikishika kisigino cha ndugu yake. \q Alipokuwa mtu mwenye nguvu, alishindana na Mungu.

vi.L: Trong lòng mẹ, người đã nắm gót anh mình, \q và khi sung sức, người đã vật lộn với Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Trong lòng mẹ, người đã nắm lấy gót anh mình, \q và khi đầy sức mạnh, người đã tranh đấu với Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Ngay cả trước khi chào đời, Gia-cốp đã nắm gót anh mình. \q Khi đã là một người mạnh mẽ, người tranh đấu với Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그는 모태에서 형의 발꿈치를 잡았고, \q 힘이 있을 때에 하나님과 겨루었다.
ko.B: 그는 어머니 배 속에서 형의 발꿈치를 붙잡았고, \q 한창 힘이 셀 때에 하나님과 겨루었다.
ko.R: 야곱은 태어나기도 전에 형의 발꿈치를 붙잡았다. \q 힘센 사람이 되어서는 하나님과 겨루었다.

decisions.choice: he grasped his brother's heel in the womb: Jacob's birth, Genesis 25:26
decisions.reason: At his birth Jacob came out holding Esau's heel, and he was named Jacob (Genesis 25:26). The verb here is formed from the word "heel" and the name Jacob, and it also means to trip up or to cheat: Esau said that Jacob had "supplanted" him twice (Genesis 27:36). Hosea sets Jacob's grasping beside Ephraim's lies and deceit (12:1).

decisions.choice: he strove with God: Jacob's wrestling at the Jabbok, Genesis 32:25-31
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in Genesis 32:29, where Jacob is given the name Israel "for you have striven with God and with men, and have prevailed". Verse 5 goes on with the same story.

decisions.choice: in his strength: in the full vigor of manhood
decisions.reason: The word means strength, vigor or wealth. The same noun returns in verse 9, where Ephraim boasts, "I have found wealth for myself." Jacob used his strength to strive with God; Ephraim uses it to get rich.

decisions.choice: Jacob's life as warning and as call
decisions.reason: Hosea uses Jacob's story both ways. The grasping at the heel is like the deceit of his descendants. But Jacob also wrestled with God, wept and begged for his favor (verse 5), and God met him at Bethel. The call of verse 7 asks Israel to turn to God as their ancestor did.

decisions.choice: strove (L); contended (B); struggled (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses the verb that Open Word Bible's Genesis 32:29 uses at that level, so a reader can hear the echo (m2).

decisions.choice: Even before Jacob was born (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in the womb" means and names Jacob, who is not named in the verse but is the subject from verse 3.

decisions.choice: "lutté" (L, R), "combattu" (B), the verbs of the published Genesis 32:29
decisions.reason: The verse recalls Genesis 32, so each level uses the verb of Genesis 32:29 at that level.

decisions.choice: "alishindana" (L, R), "alipambana" (B), the verbs of the published Genesis 32:29
decisions.reason: The verse recalls Genesis 32, so each level uses the verb of Genesis 32:29 at that level.

decisions.choice: "vật lộn" (L), "tranh đấu" (B, R), the verbs of the published Genesis 32:29; Jacob the ancestor is "người"
decisions.reason: The verse recalls Genesis 32, so each level uses the verb of Genesis 32:29 at that level. The ancestor is spoken of as "người", not with the "nó" used for the nation in verse 3.

source.text: וָיָּ֤שַׂר אֶל־מַלְאָךְ֙ וַיֻּכָ֔ל בָּכָ֖ה וַיִּתְחַנֶּן־ל֑וֹ בֵּֽית־אֵל֙ יִמְצָאֶ֔נּוּ וְשָׁ֖ם יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he strove with [the] angel and prevailed; he wept and sought favor to him; [at] Bethel he found him, and there he spoke with us.

en.L: He strove with the angel and prevailed; \q he wept and sought his favor. \q At Bethel {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} found him, \q and there {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke with us.
en.B: He contended with the angel and came through victorious; \q he wept and begged for his favor. \q At Bethel God found him, \q and there {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke with us.
en.R: He struggled with the angel and won. \q He cried and begged the angel to bless him. \q God found Jacob at Bethel, \q and there God spoke with us.

es.L: Luchó con el ángel y prevaleció; \q lloró y le suplicó su favor. \q En Betel lo halló, \q y allí habló con nosotros.
es.B: Luchó con el ángel y salió vencedor; \q lloró y le rogó que le mostrara su favor. \q En Betel Dios lo encontró, \q y allí {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló con nosotros.
es.R: Luchó con el ángel y ganó. \q Lloró y le rogó al ángel que lo bendijera. \q Dios encontró a Jacob en Betel, \q y allí Dios habló con nosotros.

fr.L: Il a lutté avec l’ange et l’a emporté ; \q il a pleuré et a imploré sa faveur. \q À Béthel {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a trouvé, \q et là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a parlé avec nous.
fr.B: Il a combattu avec l’ange et en est sorti vainqueur ; \q il a pleuré et l’a supplié de lui accorder sa faveur. \q À Béthel, Dieu l’a trouvé, \q et là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a parlé avec nous.
fr.R: Il a lutté avec l’ange et il a gagné. \q Il a pleuré et a supplié l’ange de le bénir. \q Dieu a trouvé Jacob à Béthel, \q et là, Dieu a parlé avec nous.

sw.L: Alishindana na malaika akashinda; \q alilia na kuomba fadhili zake. \q Huko Betheli alimkuta, \q na huko alisema nasi.
sw.B: Alipambana na malaika na kuibuka mshindi; \q alilia na kumsihi amfadhili. \q Huko Betheli Mungu alimkuta, \q na huko alisema nasi.
sw.R: Alishindana na malaika na kushinda. \q Alilia na kumsihi malaika ambariki. \q Mungu alimkuta Yakobo huko Betheli, \q na huko Mungu alisema nasi.

vi.L: Người đã vật lộn với thiên sứ và đã thắng; \q người đã khóc và nài xin ơn của thiên sứ. \q Tại Bê-tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã gặp người, \q và tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với chúng ta.
vi.B: Người đã tranh đấu với thiên sứ và đã thắng; \q người đã khóc lóc và nài xin ơn thiên sứ. \q Tại Bê-tên, Đức Chúa Trời đã gặp người, \q và tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với chúng ta.
vi.R: Người đã tranh đấu với thiên sứ và đã thắng. \q Người đã khóc và nài xin thiên sứ ban phước cho mình. \q Đức Chúa Trời đã gặp Gia-cốp tại Bê-tên, \q và tại đó Đức Chúa Trời đã phán với chúng ta.

ko.L: 그는 천사와 겨루어 이겼고, \q 울며 그에게 은혜를 구했다. \q 벧엘에서 그분께서 그를 만나셨고, \q 거기에서 우리와 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 그는 천사와 겨루어 이겼고, \q 울면서 은혜를 베풀어 달라고 간청했다. \q 하나님께서 벧엘에서 그를 만나셨고, \q 거기에서 그분께서 우리와 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 그는 천사와 겨루어 이겼다. \q 그는 울면서 복을 빌어 달라고 천사에게 간청했다. \q 하나님께서 벧엘에서 야곱을 만나셨고, \q 거기에서 하나님께서 우리에게 말씀하셨다.

decisions.choice: he strove with the angel and prevailed: Genesis 32:25-31
decisions.reason: Genesis calls Jacob's opponent "a man", and Jacob says afterward that he has seen God face to face (Genesis 32:25, 31). Hosea calls him "the angel", God's messenger, and in verse 4 says that Jacob strove "with God". "Prevailed" is the verb of Genesis 32:29.

decisions.choice: he wept and sought his favor: Jacob pleading for a blessing
alternatives: the angel wept and pleaded with Jacob
decisions.reason: Jacob held on and said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me" (Genesis 32:27). Genesis does not say that he wept; Hosea adds it, or tells the story as it was known in his day. The one who weeps is most naturally Jacob, the subject of the verse.

decisions.choice: At Bethel God found him: Genesis 28:10-22 and 35:1-15
decisions.reason: God met Jacob at Bethel when he fled from Esau (Genesis 28:10-22) and again when he came back (Genesis 35:9-15). The Hebrew says only "he found him"; since God is plainly the one who "spoke" in the next words, God is taken as the one who found Jacob, but the words could also mean that Jacob found God there. In Hosea's day Bethel held a golden calf (10:5; 1 Kings 12:28-29), so the place where God truly met Jacob is set against the worship there now.

decisions.choice: there he spoke with us: in speaking to Jacob, God spoke to the people descended from him
alternatives: there he spoke with him (the reading of the Greek and Syriac translations)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "with us": what God said to Jacob at Bethel was said to all Israel, Hosea's hearers included. The Greek and Syriac translations read "with him". The Hebrew is followed. This description of the ancient translations is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: strove ... prevailed (L); contended ... came through victorious (B); struggled ... won (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses the words of Open Word Bible's Genesis 32:29 at that level (m1). The angel, like the "man" of Genesis 32, is a figure in the story and takes no deity pronoun setting; "he" for God in the second half does.

decisions.choice: God found him (B); begged the angel to bless him ... God found Jacob ... God spoke (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who found Jacob, following the reading chosen in m3, and Readable says what the favor Jacob begged for was (m2).

decisions.choice: "<lo> halló" in the line about Bethel: the span is on God's finding, not on Jacob
decisions.reason: At Literal the Hebrew does not name the subject; the English spans "he" for God. Spanish has no subject pronoun here, and "lo" is Jacob, so the span is left off the Literal line at Bethel.

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh, [the] God of the hosts, Yahweh [is] his remembrance.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] the God of hosts; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} remembrance.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the God of Armies; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is the name by which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is remembered.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the God of Armies. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, the name to remember {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] el Dios de los ejércitos; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} memorial.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el Dios de los Ejércitos; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el nombre con que se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recuerda.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el Dios de los Ejércitos. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, el nombre con que se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recuerda.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] le Dieu des armées ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} mémorial.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le Dieu des armées ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le nom par lequel on se souvient de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le Dieu des armées. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, le nom par lequel on se souvient de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu wa majeshi; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndilo jina ambalo kwalo anakumbukwa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu wa majeshi. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, jina ambalo watu wanamkumbuka kwalo.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời Vạn Quân; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] danh ghi nhớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời Vạn Quân; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là danh mà người ta dùng để ghi nhớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời Vạn Quân. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là danh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, danh để người ta ghi nhớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 만군의 하나님이시다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 사람들이 그분을 기억하며 부르는 이름이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 하나님이시다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그분의 이름이다. 그 이름으로 그분을 기억해야 한다.

decisions.choice: the LORD is his remembrance: the name by which God is remembered, Exodus 3:15
decisions.reason: At the burning bush God told Moses, "This is my name forever, and this is my remembrance from generation to generation" (Exodus 3:15). The God who met Jacob at Bethel (verse 5) and said "I am the LORD" (Genesis 28:13) is the LORD, not a Baal and not the calf now worshiped there.

decisions.choice: a short hymn of praise inside the accusation
decisions.reason: The verse breaks off the story to name the God of the story, as hymn lines break into the prophecies of Amos (Amos 4:13; 5:8). "Hosts" are the armies of heaven; the main note on the title is at Isaiah 1:9.

decisions.choice: the God of hosts (L); the God of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: The title as set for the prophets. Balanced and Readable say what "remembrance" means, as Exodus 3:15 does at those levels.

decisions.choice: "el Dios de los ejércitos" (L); "el Dios de los Ejércitos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for "the God of hosts" in the Twelve.

decisions.choice: "memorial"
decisions.reason: The word of Exodus 3:15 for the name by which God is remembered; Balanced and Readable say it out, as the English does.

source.text: וְאַתָּ֖ה בֵּאלֹהֶ֣יךָ תָשׁ֑וּב חֶ֤סֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט֙ שְׁמֹ֔ר וְקַוֵּ֥ה אֶל־אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ תָּמִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, by your God you will return; loyal love and justice keep, and wait for your God continually.

en.L: And you, by your God you will return; \q keep loyal love and justice, \q and wait for your God continually.
en.B: But you, with your God's help, must return. \q Hold on to loyal love and justice, \q and wait for your God continually.
en.R: So come back, with your God's help. \q Keep on showing faithful love and doing what is just, \q and always wait for your God.

es.L: Y tú, con [la ayuda de] tu Dios volverás; \q guarda el amor leal y el derecho, \q y espera en tu Dios continuamente.
es.B: Pero tú, con la ayuda de tu Dios, tienes que volver. \q Aférrate al amor fiel y al derecho, \q y espera siempre en tu Dios.
es.R: Así que vuelve, con la ayuda de tu Dios. \q Sigue mostrando amor fiel y haciendo lo que es justo, \q y espera siempre en tu Dios.

fr.L: Et toi, par ton Dieu tu reviendras ; \q garde l’amour loyal et le droit, \q et espère en ton Dieu continuellement.
fr.B: Mais toi, avec l’aide de ton Dieu, tu dois revenir. \q Attache-toi à l’amour fidèle et au droit, \q et espère en ton Dieu continuellement.
fr.R: Alors reviens, avec l’aide de ton Dieu. \q Continue à montrer un amour fidèle et à faire ce qui est juste, \q et attends toujours ton Dieu.

sw.L: Na wewe, kwa Mungu wako utarudi; \q shika upendo usiokoma na hukumu, \q na umngojee Mungu wako daima.
sw.B: Lakini wewe, kwa msaada wa Mungu wako, ni lazima urudi. \q Shikilia upendo usiokoma na haki, \q na umngojee Mungu wako daima.
sw.R: Basi rudi, kwa msaada wa Mungu wako. \q Endelea kuonyesha upendo usiokoma na kutenda yaliyo haki, \q na umngoje Mungu wako siku zote.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, nhờ Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, ngươi sẽ trở về; \q hãy giữ tình yêu thương thành tín và công lý, \q và hãy luôn trông đợi Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi.
vi.B: Nhưng ngươi, nhờ sự giúp đỡ của Đức Chúa Trời mình, phải trở về. \q Hãy giữ vững tình yêu thương thành tín và công lý, \q và hãy luôn trông đợi Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi.
vi.R: Vậy hãy trở về, nhờ sự giúp đỡ của Đức Chúa Trời. \q Hãy tiếp tục sống với tình thương không hề thay đổi và làm điều công bằng, \q và hãy luôn trông đợi Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi.

ko.L: 그러니 너는 네 하나님의 [도우심으로] 돌아올 것이다. \q 한결같은 사랑과 정의를 지키고, \q 늘 네 하나님을 기다려라.
ko.B: 그러므로 너는 네 하나님의 도우심을 힘입어 돌아와야 한다. \q 한결같은 사랑과 정의를 굳게 지키고, \q 언제나 네 하나님을 기다려라.
ko.R: 그러니 네 하나님의 도우심을 받아 돌아오너라. \q 변함없는 사랑을 계속 베풀고 옳은 일을 하여라. \q 그리고 언제나 네 하나님을 기다려라.

decisions.choice: by your God you will return: return, with God's help
decisions.reason: The small word before "your God" usually means "in" or "by", so the line says that Israel will return by God's help. Jacob, too, was promised that God would bring him back (Genesis 28:15, 21). Many take it as "to your God", which the next line's "wait for your God" also suits. The verb can be a promise or a command; with the commands that follow, it is a call to come back.

decisions.choice: loyal love and justice: faithfulness to God and fairness to others
decisions.reason: These are the things God looks for in place of sacrifice (6:6; 10:12). Loyal love is steadfast faithfulness within a covenant; justice is right dealing, the opposite of the false scales of verse 8.

decisions.choice: wait for your God continually: keep trusting and hoping in God
decisions.reason: To wait for God is to look to him in hope and trust, not to Assyria or Egypt (12:2; compare Isaiah 40:31).

decisions.choice: loyal love (L, B); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: The word as set for the prophets.

decisions.choice: must return (B); come back (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take the verb as a call, as the commands that follow do (m1); Literal keeps "you will return".

decisions.choice: "el derecho" (L, B); "lo que es justo" (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat as the terms note sets for the Spanish prophets.

source.text: כְּנַ֗עַן בְּיָד֛וֹ מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִרְמָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אָהֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: A Canaan, in his hand [are] scales of deceit; to defraud he loves.

en.L: A trader, in his hand [are] scales of deceit; he loves to defraud.
en.B: A merchant with dishonest scales in his hand loves to cheat.
en.R: Ephraim is like a dishonest trader who cheats with false scales. He loves to cheat people.

es.L: Un mercader, en su mano [hay] balanzas de engaño; ama defraudar.
es.B: Un comerciante con balanzas falsas en la mano ama estafar.
es.R: Efraín es como un comerciante deshonesto que engaña con balanzas falsas. Le encanta estafar a la gente.

fr.L: Un marchand, dans sa main [sont] des balances de tromperie ; il aime extorquer.
fr.B: Un marchand qui tient en main des balances truquées aime frauder.
fr.R: Éphraïm est comme un marchand malhonnête qui triche avec de fausses balances. Il aime tromper les gens.

sw.L: Mfanyabiashara, mkononi mwake [mna] mizani ya udanganyifu; anapenda kudhulumu.
sw.B: Mfanyabiashara mwenye mizani ya udanganyifu mkononi mwake anapenda kudhulumu.
sw.R: Efraimu ni kama mfanyabiashara mdanganyifu anayedanganya kwa mizani isiyo sahihi. Anapenda kuwadhulumu watu.

vi.L: Một con buôn, trong tay [có] cân gian dối; nó ưa lừa đảo.
vi.B: Một tay lái buôn cầm cân gian trong tay, ưa thích lừa gạt.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im giống như một con buôn bất lương, dùng cân gian để lừa người. Nó thích lừa gạt người ta.

ko.L: 장사꾼, 그 손에 속이는 저울이 [있고], 그는 착취하기를 좋아한다.
ko.B: 손에 거짓 저울을 든 장사꾼이 속이기를 좋아한다.
ko.R: 에브라임은 거짓 저울로 속이는 정직하지 못한 장사꾼과 같다. 그는 사람들을 속이기를 좋아한다.

decisions.choice: a trader: the word is also the name Canaan
decisions.reason: The word is the name of the land and people of Canaan. The Canaanites of the coast were famous traders, so the word came to mean a merchant (Isaiah 23:8; Zephaniah 1:11; Proverbs 31:24). Calling Ephraim this says that Israel has become like the Canaanites whose gods it worships.

decisions.choice: scales of deceit: false weights for cheating buyers
decisions.reason: Goods were weighed in the scales against stone weights, and a cheat could use a false weight or a bent balance. The law demanded honest scales (Leviticus 19:36; Proverbs 11:1), and the prophets condemned false ones (Amos 8:5; Micah 6:11).

decisions.choice: defraud: wrong others by extortion
decisions.reason: The verb means to take what belongs to another by force or fraud, especially from the weak (Leviticus 5:21; Amos 4:1).

decisions.choice: Ephraim is like a dishonest trader (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says who the trader is, since verse 9 makes it Ephraim, and states the comparison. The verse is a single line in the Hebrew and is not broken at any level.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶפְרַ֔יִם אַ֣ךְ עָשַׁ֔רְתִּי מָצָ֥אתִי א֖וֹן לִ֑י כָּל־יְגִיעַ֕י לֹ֥א יִמְצְאוּ־לִ֖י עָוֺ֥ן אֲשֶׁר־חֵֽטְא׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Ephraim, surely I have become rich, I have found wealth for myself; [in] all my labors not they will find in me iniquity that [is] sin.

en.L: And Ephraim said, "Surely I have become rich; \q I have found wealth for myself. \q In all my labors \q they will not find in me iniquity that [is] sin."
en.B: Ephraim says, "I have become rich indeed; \q I have gained wealth for myself. \q In all my hard work \q no one will find any wrongdoing that counts as sin."
en.R: Ephraim boasts, "I am rich! \q I have made a fortune for myself. \q In all I have worked for, \q no one can show that I have done anything wrong."

es.L: Y Efraín dijo: «Ciertamente me he enriquecido; \q he hallado riqueza para mí. \q En todos mis trabajos \q no hallarán en mí iniquidad que [sea] pecado».
es.B: Efraín dice: «En verdad me he hecho rico; \q he ganado riquezas para mí. \q En todo mi esfuerzo \q nadie hallará ninguna falta que cuente como pecado».
es.R: Efraín se jacta: «¡Soy rico! \q He hecho una fortuna para mí. \q En todo lo que he trabajado, \q nadie puede demostrar que haya hecho algo malo».

fr.L: Et Éphraïm a dit : « Certes, je me suis enrichi ; \q j’ai trouvé de la richesse pour moi. \q Dans tous mes travaux \q on ne trouvera pas en moi d’iniquité qui [soit] péché. »
fr.B: Éphraïm dit : « Oui, je suis devenu riche ; \q je me suis acquis une fortune. \q Dans tout mon labeur \q personne ne trouvera de faute qui compte comme péché. »
fr.R: Éphraïm se vante : « Je suis riche ! \q Je me suis fait une fortune. \q Dans tout ce pour quoi j’ai travaillé, \q personne ne peut prouver que j’ai fait quelque chose de mal. »

sw.L: Naye Efraimu alisema, "Hakika nimetajirika; \q nimejipatia mali. \q Katika kazi zangu zote \q hawataona ndani yangu uovu ulio dhambi."
sw.B: Efraimu anasema, "Kweli nimekuwa tajiri; \q nimejipatia mali. \q Katika bidii yangu yote \q hakuna atakayeona kosa lolote linalohesabiwa kuwa dhambi."
sw.R: Efraimu anajisifu, "Mimi ni tajiri! \q Nimejipatia utajiri mkubwa. \q Katika yote niliyoyafanyia kazi, \q hakuna anayeweza kuonyesha kwamba nimefanya kosa lolote."

vi.L: Ép-ra-im đã nói: "Chắc chắn ta đã trở nên giàu có; \q ta đã tìm được của cải cho mình. \q Trong mọi công lao của ta, \q người ta sẽ không tìm thấy nơi ta sự gian ác nào là tội lỗi."
vi.B: Ép-ra-im nói: "Thật vậy, ta đã trở nên giàu có; \q ta đã thu được của cải cho mình. \q Trong mọi công khó của ta, \q không ai tìm thấy điều sai trái nào đáng gọi là tội."
vi.R: Ép-ra-im khoe khoang: "Ta giàu rồi! \q Ta đã làm nên một gia tài cho mình. \q Trong mọi việc ta làm, \q không ai có thể chứng minh ta đã làm điều gì sai."

ko.L: 에브라임이 말했다. "참으로 내가 부자가 되었고, \q 나를 위해 재물을 얻었다. \q 내 모든 수고에서 \q 사람들이 내게서 죄가 될 만한 악을 찾지 못할 것이다."
ko.B: 에브라임은 말한다. "나는 정말 부자가 되었다. \q 나를 위해 재산을 모았다. \q 내가 애써 한 모든 일에서 \q 죄라고 할 만한 잘못은 아무도 찾지 못할 것이다."
ko.R: 에브라임은 자랑한다. "나는 부자다! \q 큰 재산을 모았다. \q 내가 일해서 얻은 것 가운데 \q 내가 잘못했다고 밝힐 수 있는 사람은 아무도 없다!"

decisions.choice: wealth: the same word as "strength" in verse 4
decisions.reason: Jacob used his strength to strive with God (verse 4); Ephraim's strength is its money. The word also sounds like "wickedness" in verse 12.

decisions.choice: Ephraim's boast goes on: no one will find guilt in my dealings
alternatives: the prophet's answer: all his gains will not make up for the guilt he has incurred (close to the reading of the Greek translation)
decisions.reason: As the Hebrew stands, the merchant of verse 8 claims that his profits are clean: no one can prove any sin against him. The Greek translation reads the line differently, as a reply that his gains will not be enough to cover his guilt. The Hebrew is followed. This description of the Greek is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: iniquity that is sin: wrong that could be proved as a real offense
decisions.reason: Ephraim speaks like a man in court: there may be sharp dealing, but nothing anyone can call sin. The boast is answered by verse 10 and by the charge of verse 15.

decisions.choice: says (B); boasts (R); wrongdoing that counts as sin (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb can describe what Ephraim says now. Ephraim's words are quoted inside the prophecy, so they take double quotation marks.

source.text: וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עֹ֛ד אוֹשִֽׁיבְךָ֥ בָאֳהָלִ֖ים כִּימֵ֥י מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, Yahweh, your God from [the] land of Egypt; again I will make you dwell in tents as [the] days of [the] appointed feast.

en.L: But I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God from the land of Egypt; \q I will again make you live in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
en.B: But I have been {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God since you were in the land of Egypt; \q I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of the appointed festival.
en.R: But I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I have been your God ever since you were in Egypt. \q I will make you live in tents again, as you do at the yearly festival.

es.L: Pero yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios desde la tierra de Egipto; \q aún te haré habitar en tiendas, como en los días de la fiesta señalada.
es.B: Pero yo he sido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios desde que estabas en la tierra de Egipto; \q te haré vivir otra vez en tiendas, como en los días de la fiesta solemne.
es.R: Pero yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. He sido tu Dios desde que estabas en Egipto. \q Te haré vivir otra vez en tiendas, como lo haces en la fiesta de cada año.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, [je suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu depuis le pays d’Égypte ; \q je te ferai encore habiter sous des tentes, comme aux jours de la fête solennelle.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu depuis que tu étais au pays d’Égypte ; \q je te ferai de nouveau habiter sous des tentes, comme aux jours de la fête fixée.
fr.R: Mais je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je suis ton Dieu depuis que tu étais en Égypte. \q Je te ferai de nouveau vivre sous des tentes, comme tu le fais à la fête de chaque année.

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako tangu nchi ya Misri; \q nitakukalisha tena katika hema, kama katika siku za sikukuu iliyoamriwa.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimekuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako tangu ulipokuwa katika nchi ya Misri; \q nitakufanya uishi tena katika hema, kama katika siku za sikukuu iliyoamriwa.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nimekuwa Mungu wako tangu ulipokuwa Misri. \q Nitakufanya uishi tena katika hema, kama unavyofanya katika sikukuu ya kila mwaka.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi từ đất Ai Cập; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại cho ngươi ở trong lều trại, như trong những ngày lễ đã định.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi từ khi ngươi còn ở đất Ai Cập; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại cho ngươi sống trong lều trại, như trong những ngày lễ đã định.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ta là Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi từ khi ngươi còn ở Ai Cập. \q Ta sẽ lại cho ngươi sống trong lều trại, như khi ngươi dự lễ hằng năm.

ko.L: 그러나 나는 이집트 땅에서부터 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다. \q 내가 너를 정한 절기의 날처럼 다시 장막에 살게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 네가 이집트 땅에 있을 때부터 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}였다. \q 정한 절기 때처럼 내가 너를 다시 장막에 살게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. 네가 이집트에 있을 때부터 나는 네 하나님이었다. \q 해마다 지키는 절기 때처럼 내가 너를 다시 장막에서 살게 하겠다.

decisions.choice: I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt: God's claim on Israel goes back to the exodus
decisions.reason: The words are the same in 13:4, and they echo the opening of the Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:2). Against Ephraim's boast of wealth (verse 9), God names what Israel owes him.

decisions.choice: live in tents again, as in the days of the appointed feast: back to the wilderness, which the Feast of Booths recalls
alternatives: a threat of losing house and land only
decisions.reason: At the Feast of Booths Israel lived in shelters for a week to remember the wilderness journey (Leviticus 23:42-43). Here the wilderness is a threat: God will strip away the wealth Ephraim boasts of and send it back to tents. But in Hosea the wilderness is also where God renews his people (2:16-17). Both senses may be meant.

decisions.choice: since you were in the land of Egypt (B); ever since you were in Egypt (R); the yearly festival (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that "from the land of Egypt" means "since that time" (m1). Readable says "the yearly festival" for "the appointed feast"; the note explains which one.

source.text: וְדִבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְאָנֹכִ֖י חָז֣וֹן הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי וּבְיַ֥ד הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֲדַמֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I spoke to the prophets, and I, vision I multiplied, and by [the] hand of the prophets I gave parables.

en.L: And I spoke to the prophets, \q and I multiplied visions, \q and by the hand of the prophets I gave parables.
en.B: I spoke to the prophets; \q I gave them vision after vision, \q and through the prophets I spoke in parables.
en.R: I spoke to the prophets. \q I gave them many visions. \q Through the prophets I taught {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people with word pictures.

es.L: Y hablé a los profetas, \q y yo multipliqué la visión, \q y por medio de los profetas puse comparaciones.
es.B: Hablé a los profetas; \q les di visión tras visión, \q y por medio de los profetas hablé en parábolas.
es.R: Hablé a los profetas. \q Les di muchas visiones. \q Por medio de los profetas enseñé a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo con imágenes.

fr.L: Et j’ai parlé aux prophètes, \q et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, j’ai multiplié les visions, \q et par la main des prophètes j’ai donné des paraboles.
fr.B: J’ai parlé aux prophètes ; \q je leur ai donné vision sur vision, \q et par les prophètes j’ai parlé en paraboles.
fr.R: J’ai parlé aux prophètes. \q Je leur ai donné beaucoup de visions. \q Par les prophètes, j’ai enseigné {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple avec des images.

sw.L: Nami nilisema na manabii, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} niliongeza maono, \q na kwa mkono wa manabii nilitoa mifano.
sw.B: Nilisema na manabii; \q niliwapa maono baada ya maono, \q na kupitia manabii nilisema kwa mifano.
sw.R: Nilisema na manabii. \q Niliwapa maono mengi. \q Kupitia manabii niliwafundisha watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa mifano.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán với các nhà tiên tri, \q và chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gia tăng khải tượng, \q và qua tay các nhà tiên tri {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban những ví dụ.
vi.B: Ta đã phán với các nhà tiên tri; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho họ hết khải tượng này đến khải tượng khác, \q và qua các nhà tiên tri {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán bằng ẩn dụ.
vi.R: Ta đã phán với các nhà tiên tri. \q Ta đã cho họ thấy nhiều khải tượng. \q Qua các nhà tiên tri, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dạy dỗ dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những hình ảnh.

ko.L: 내가 예언자들에게 말하였고, \q 내가 환상을 많게 하였으며, \q 예언자들의 손을 통해 비유를 주었다.
ko.B: 나는 예언자들에게 말했다. \q 그들에게 환상을 거듭 보여 주었고, \q 예언자들을 통해 비유로 말했다.
ko.R: 나는 예언자들에게 말했다. \q 그들에게 많은 환상을 보여 주었다. \q 예언자들을 통해 그림 같은 말로 내 백성을 가르쳤다.

decisions.choice: I gave parables: God spoke in comparisons and pictures
alternatives: I will bring destruction (the same letters form the verb "destroy" used in 4:5-6)
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to liken or to compare, so God spoke through the prophets in pictures, as Hosea's own marriage and the names of his children were pictures. The same letters can also be a verb meaning "destroy" (4:5-6; compare 6:5, "I have cut them down by the prophets"). The first sense is followed.

decisions.choice: God has not been silent: the prophets were his warning
decisions.reason: Ephraim cannot plead ignorance. God spoke through prophets from Moses (verse 14) to Hosea himself. "By the hand of" means through someone, as an agent.

decisions.choice: vision after vision (B); taught my people with word pictures (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "multiplied visions" in plain words. Readable supplies "my people" as those taught, and says "word pictures" for parables. God is the speaker, so "my" takes the deity pronoun setting.

source.text: אִם־גִּלְעָ֥ד אָ֨וֶן֙ אַךְ־שָׁ֣וְא הָי֔וּ בַּגִּלְגָּ֖ל שְׁוָרִ֣ים זִבֵּ֑חוּ גַּ֤ם מִזְבְּחוֹתָם֙ כְּגַלִּ֔ים עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: If Gilead [is] wickedness, surely worthlessness they have become; in Gilgal bulls they sacrificed; also their altars [are] like heaps on [the] furrows of [the] field.

en.L: If Gilead [is] wickedness, surely they have become nothing; \q in Gilgal they sacrifice bulls; \q their altars also [will be] like heaps of stones \q on the furrows of the field.
en.B: If Gilead is wicked, they have surely come to nothing. \q In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls; \q their altars too will be like heaps of stones \q along the furrows of a field.
en.R: Gilead is full of evil, and its people will come to nothing. \q In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls, \q but their altars will become piles of stones \q like the rocks cleared from a plowed field.

es.L: Si Galaad [es] maldad, ciertamente se han vuelto nada; \q en Guilgal sacrifican toros; \q también sus altares [serán] como montones de piedras \q en los surcos del campo.
es.B: Si Galaad es malvada, sin duda ha quedado en nada. \q En Guilgal sacrifican toros; \q también sus altares serán como montones de piedras \q a lo largo de los surcos de un campo.
es.R: Galaad está llena de maldad, y su gente acabará en nada. \q En Guilgal sacrifican toros, \q pero sus altares se convertirán en montones de piedras \q como las que se quitan de un campo arado.

fr.L: Si Galaad [est] iniquité, certainement ils sont devenus néant ; \q à Guilgal ils sacrifient des taureaux ; \q leurs autels aussi [seront] comme des tas de pierres \q sur les sillons des champs.
fr.B: Si Galaad est mauvais, ils sont sûrement réduits à rien. \q À Guilgal, ils sacrifient des taureaux ; \q leurs autels aussi seront comme des tas de pierres \q le long des sillons d’un champ.
fr.R: Galaad est plein de mal, et ses habitants finiront en rien. \q À Guilgal, ils sacrifient des taureaux, \q mais leurs autels deviendront des tas de pierres \q comme les cailloux qu’on retire d’un champ labouré.

sw.L: Ikiwa Gileadi [ni] uovu, hakika wamekuwa bure; \q huko Gilgali wanatoa dhabihu za mafahali; \q madhabahu zao nazo [zitakuwa] kama marundo ya mawe \q katika mifereji ya shamba.
sw.B: Ikiwa Gileadi ni mwovu, hakika wamekuwa si kitu. \q Huko Gilgali wanatoa dhabihu za mafahali; \q madhabahu zao nazo zitakuwa kama marundo ya mawe \q kando ya mitaro ya shamba.
sw.R: Gileadi imejaa uovu, na watu wake wataishia kuwa si kitu. \q Huko Gilgali wanatoa dhabihu za mafahali, \q lakini madhabahu zao zitakuwa marundo ya mawe \q kama mawe yanayoondolewa katika shamba lililolimwa.

vi.L: Nếu Ga-la-át [là] gian ác, thì chắc chắn chúng đã trở nên hư không; \q tại Ghinh-ganh chúng dâng bò đực làm sinh tế; \q bàn thờ của chúng cũng [sẽ] như những đống đá \q trên các luống cày ngoài đồng.
vi.B: Nếu Ga-la-át gian ác, chắc chắn chúng đã trở nên vô giá trị. \q Tại Ghinh-ganh chúng dâng bò đực làm sinh tế; \q bàn thờ của chúng cũng sẽ như những đống đá \q dọc theo luống cày ngoài đồng.
vi.R: Ga-la-át đầy dẫy điều ác, và dân ở đó sẽ trở thành hư không. \q Tại Ghinh-ganh chúng dâng bò đực làm sinh tế, \q nhưng bàn thờ của chúng sẽ thành những đống đá \q như đá người ta nhặt ra khỏi ruộng đã cày.

ko.L: 길르앗이 악하다면, 그들은 참으로 헛것이 되었다. \q 길갈에서 그들이 수소를 제물로 바치니, \q 그들의 제단들도 밭이랑에 [쌓인] \q 돌무더기 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 길르앗이 악하다면, 그들은 틀림없이 아무것도 아닌 것이 되었다. \q 길갈에서 그들은 수소를 제물로 바친다. \q 그들의 제단도 밭이랑을 따라 쌓인 \q 돌무더기처럼 될 것이다.
ko.R: 길르앗은 악으로 가득하니, 그 백성은 아무것도 아닌 것이 될 것이다. \q 길갈에서 그들이 수소를 제물로 바치지만, \q 그들의 제단은 돌무더기가 될 것이다. \q 갈아 놓은 밭에서 골라낸 돌무더기처럼 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: Gilead, Gilgal and heaps (gallim): a play on sounds
decisions.reason: The names Gilead and Gilgal and the word for heaps of stones sound alike. Gilgal's name was explained by the stones set up there (Joshua 4:19-20; 5:9). Its altars will end as what the names sound like: heaps of rubble. "Wickedness" also sounds like the Beth-aven of 4:15.

decisions.choice: If Gilead is wickedness, surely they have become nothing: a condition known to be true
alternatives: a question: Is Gilead wicked? They have become nothing.
decisions.reason: "If" here introduces something everyone knows: Gilead, "a city of evildoers" (6:8), is wicked, so its people are worthless. The verb is past, "they have become", as if the end had already come. The line is hard, and it can also be read as a question.

decisions.choice: bulls sacrificed at Gilgal: worship at an old holy place
decisions.reason: Gilgal, near Jericho, was a holy place from Joshua's day, and in Hosea's time a center of the worship he condemns (4:15; 9:15; Amos 4:4; 5:5).

decisions.choice: heaps on the furrows of the field: piles of stones cleared from plowed land
decisions.reason: Farmers gathered stones from their fields into heaps along the edges. The altars will be no more than such piles.

decisions.choice: Gilead is full of evil, and its people will come to nothing (R); the rocks cleared from a plowed field (R)
decisions.reason: Readable states the condition as the fact it assumes (m2) and explains the heaps of stones (m4).

source.text: וַיִּבְרַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׂדֵ֣ה אֲרָ֑ם וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאִשָּׁ֔ה וּבְאִשָּׁ֖ה שָׁמָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And fled Jacob [to the] field of Aram, and served Israel for a wife, and for a wife he kept.

en.L: And Jacob fled to Aram's open country; \q and Israel served for a wife, \q and for a wife he tended [sheep].
en.B: Jacob fled to the land of Aram; \q Israel worked to earn a wife, \q and for a wife he tended sheep.
en.R: Jacob ran away to the land of Aram. \q There Israel worked to get a wife. \q He took care of sheep to pay for a wife.

es.L: Y Jacob huyó a los campos de Aram; \q e Israel sirvió por una mujer, \q y por una mujer guardó [ovejas].
es.B: Jacob huyó a la tierra de Aram; \q Israel trabajó para ganarse una esposa, \q y por una esposa cuidó ovejas.
es.R: Jacob huyó a la tierra de Aram. \q Allí Israel trabajó para conseguir esposa. \q Cuidó ovejas para pagar por una esposa.

fr.L: Et Jacob s’est enfui dans la campagne d’Aram ; \q et Israël a servi pour une femme, \q et pour une femme il a gardé [les troupeaux].
fr.B: Jacob s’est enfui au pays d’Aram ; \q Israël a travaillé pour obtenir une femme, \q et pour une femme il a gardé les brebis.
fr.R: Jacob s’est enfui au pays d’Aram. \q Là, Israël a travaillé pour avoir une femme. \q Il a gardé des moutons pour payer une épouse.

sw.L: Naye Yakobo alikimbilia nchi ya Aramu; \q na Israeli alitumika kwa ajili ya mke, \q na kwa ajili ya mke alichunga [kondoo].
sw.B: Yakobo alikimbilia nchi ya Aramu; \q Israeli alifanya kazi ili apate mke, \q na kwa ajili ya mke alichunga kondoo.
sw.R: Yakobo alikimbilia nchi ya Aramu. \q Huko Israeli alifanya kazi ili apate mke. \q Alichunga kondoo ili alipe mahari ya mke.

vi.L: Và Gia-cốp đã trốn sang đồng ruộng A-ram; \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm việc vì một người vợ, \q và vì một người vợ người đã chăn [chiên].
vi.B: Gia-cốp đã trốn sang xứ A-ram; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm việc để được một người vợ, \q và vì một người vợ người đã chăn chiên.
vi.R: Gia-cốp đã trốn sang xứ A-ram. \q Tại đó Y-sơ-ra-ên làm việc để cưới vợ. \q Người chăn chiên để trả giá cho một người vợ.

ko.L: 야곱은 아람 들판으로 도망하였고, \q 이스라엘은 아내를 얻으려고 섬겼으며, \q 아내를 얻으려고 [양을] 쳤다.
ko.B: 야곱은 아람 땅으로 도망했고, \q 이스라엘은 아내를 얻으려고 일했으며, \q 아내를 얻으려고 양을 쳤다.
ko.R: 야곱은 아람 땅으로 도망쳤다. \q 거기서 이스라엘은 아내를 얻으려고 일했다. \q 아내를 얻는 값으로 양을 쳤다.

decisions.choice: Jacob fled to the field of Aram: Genesis 27:43; 28:5, 10
decisions.reason: Jacob fled from Esau to his uncle Laban in Paddan-aram, the region around Haran (Genesis 27:43; 28:5, 10). "The field of Aram" is the open country of Aram.

decisions.choice: Israel served for a wife: Jacob's years of work for Rachel, Genesis 29:18-20
decisions.reason: Jacob worked seven years for Rachel and seven more after Laban gave him Leah first, fourteen in all (Genesis 29:18-30; 31:41). The repeated "for a wife" stresses how long he served. Hosea calls the man both Jacob and Israel.

decisions.choice: kept: guarded the flock
decisions.reason: The verb means to keep or guard, here sheep (Genesis 30:31). It returns in verse 14: Jacob kept sheep for a wife, but God kept Israel by a prophet. Israel's story is one of being kept by God, not of its own strength.

decisions.choice: served (L); worked (B, R); tended [sheep] (L), tended sheep (B)
decisions.reason: Each level uses the verb that Open Word Bible's Genesis 29:18-20 uses at that level. The verb for tending is "keep" (m3); "tended" is the English for keeping a flock. Literal brackets "sheep", which the Hebrew leaves implied.

decisions.choice: "a servi" (L), "a travaillé" (B, R), the verbs of the published Genesis 29:20
decisions.reason: The verse recalls Jacob's years with Laban, so each level uses the verb of Genesis 29:20 at that level.

decisions.choice: "섬겼으며" (L), "일했으며" (B, R), the verbs of the published Genesis 29:20
decisions.reason: The verse recalls Jacob's years with Laban, so each level uses the verb of Genesis 29:20 at that level.

records.literal_gloss: And by a prophet Yahweh brought up Israel from Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept.

en.L: And by a prophet {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought Israel up from Egypt, \q and by a prophet he was kept.
en.B: By a prophet {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought Israel up from Egypt, \q and by a prophet Israel was kept safe.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt. \q He used a prophet to keep them safe.

es.L: Y por un profeta {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo subir a Israel de Egipto, \q y por un profeta fue guardado.
es.B: Por medio de un profeta {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sacó a Israel de Egipto, \q y por medio de un profeta Israel fue protegido.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} usó a un profeta para sacar a Israel de Egipto. \q Usó a un profeta para protegerlo.

fr.L: Et par un prophète {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait monter Israël d’Égypte, \q et par un prophète il a été gardé.
fr.B: Par un prophète, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait monter Israël d’Égypte, \q et par un prophète Israël a été protégé.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est servi d’un prophète pour faire monter Israël d’Égypte. \q Il s’est servi d’un prophète pour le protéger.

sw.L: Na kwa nabii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpandisha Israeli kutoka Misri, \q na kwa nabii alilindwa.
sw.B: Kwa njia ya nabii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpandisha Israeli kutoka Misri, \q na kwa njia ya nabii Israeli alilindwa salama.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimtumia nabii kumtoa Israeli Misri. \q Alimtumia nabii kuwalinda salama.

vi.L: Và bởi một nhà tiên tri, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi Ai Cập, \q và bởi một nhà tiên tri nó đã được gìn giữ.
vi.B: Qua một nhà tiên tri, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi Ai Cập, \q và qua một nhà tiên tri, Y-sơ-ra-ên được gìn giữ an toàn.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dùng một nhà tiên tri để đem Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập. \q Ngài đã dùng một nhà tiên tri để gìn giữ họ an toàn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한 예언자를 통해 이스라엘을 이집트에서 이끌어 올리셨고, \q 한 예언자를 통해 그가 지켜졌다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한 예언자를 통해 이스라엘을 이집트에서 이끌어 내셨고, \q 한 예언자를 통해 이스라엘이 안전하게 보호받았다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 한 예언자를 쓰셔서 이스라엘을 이집트에서 이끌어 내셨다. \q 한 예언자를 쓰셔서 그들을 안전하게 지키셨다.

decisions.choice: a prophet: Moses
decisions.reason: The prophet who led Israel out of Egypt and through the wilderness was Moses, the greatest of the prophets (Numbers 12:6-8; Deuteronomy 18:15; 34:10). Verse 11 has just said that God speaks through prophets; Ephraim rejects them (9:7-8).

decisions.choice: he was kept: guarded, as a shepherd keeps a flock
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for Jacob's keeping of sheep in verse 13. Jacob served and kept sheep for a wife; Israel was kept by God through a prophet.

decisions.choice: kept safe (B, R); Israel (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "safe" to make the sense of guarding plain (m2). Balanced names Israel so that "he" is not taken as the prophet.

source.text: הִכְעִ֥יס אֶפְרַ֖יִם תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים וְדָמָיו֙ עָלָ֣יו יִטּ֔וֹשׁ וְחֶ֨רְפָּת֔וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב ל֖וֹ אֲדֹנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Has provoked Ephraim bitterly; and his blood on him he will leave, and his reproach will return to him his Lord.

en.L: Ephraim has given bitter offense; \q and his bloodguilt {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will leave on him, \q and his reproach his Lord will return to him.
en.B: Ephraim has bitterly provoked God, \q so his Lord will leave the guilt of his bloodshed on him \q and pay him back for his contempt.
en.R: Ephraim has made God bitterly angry. \q So his Lord will hold him guilty for the blood he has shed. \q He will pay Ephraim back for the insults he has given.

es.L: Efraín ha provocado amargamente; \q y su sangre dejará sobre él, \q y su oprobio le devolverá su Señor.
es.B: Efraín ha provocado a Dios con amargura, \q así que su Señor dejará sobre él la culpa de la sangre que derramó \q y le pagará por su desprecio.
es.R: Efraín ha hecho enojar mucho a Dios. \q Por eso su Señor lo hará culpable de la sangre que ha derramado. \q Le pagará a Efraín por los insultos que ha dicho.

fr.L: Éphraïm a offensé amèrement ; \q et son sang, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le laissera sur lui, \q et son opprobre, son Seigneur le lui rendra.
fr.B: Éphraïm a amèrement provoqué Dieu ; \q aussi son Seigneur laissera sur lui la culpabilité du sang qu’il a versé \q et lui rendra son mépris.
fr.R: Éphraïm a rendu Dieu profondément furieux. \q Alors son Seigneur le tiendra coupable du sang qu’il a versé. \q Il fera payer à Éphraïm les insultes qu’il a proférées.

sw.L: Efraimu amechokoza kwa uchungu; \q na damu yake ataiacha juu yake, \q na aibu yake Bwana wake atamrudishia.
sw.B: Efraimu amemkasirisha Mungu kwa uchungu, \q kwa hiyo Bwana wake ataiacha juu yake hatia ya damu aliyoimwaga \q na kumlipa kwa dharau yake.
sw.R: Efraimu amemkasirisha Mungu sana. \q Kwa hiyo Bwana wake atamhesabu kuwa na hatia kwa damu aliyoimwaga. \q Atamlipa Efraimu kwa matukano aliyoyatoa.

vi.L: Ép-ra-im đã chọc giận cay đắng; \q và máu của nó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ để lại trên nó, \q và sự sỉ nhục của nó, Chúa của nó sẽ báo trả cho nó.
vi.B: Ép-ra-im đã chọc giận Đức Chúa Trời cách cay đắng, \q nên Chúa của nó sẽ để tội làm đổ máu lại trên nó \q và báo trả nó về sự khinh miệt của nó.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im đã làm cho Đức Chúa Trời vô cùng giận dữ. \q Vì thế Chúa của nó sẽ bắt nó chịu tội về máu nó đã đổ. \q Ngài sẽ báo trả Ép-ra-im về những lời sỉ nhục nó đã nói.

ko.L: 에브라임이 몹시 노엽게 하였으니, \q 그분께서 그의 피를 그에게 남겨 두시고, \q 그의 주님께서 그의 모욕을 그에게 되돌리실 것이다.
ko.B: 에브라임이 하나님을 몹시 노엽게 하였으니, \q 그의 주님께서 그가 흘린 피의 죄를 그에게 지우시고 \q 그의 멸시를 그에게 갚으실 것이다.
ko.R: 에브라임은 하나님을 몹시 노하시게 했다. \q 그래서 그의 주님께서 그가 흘린 피에 대해 그에게 책임을 물으실 것이다. \q 에브라임이 퍼부은 모욕을 그에게 되갚으실 것이다.

decisions.choice: has given bitter offense: has roused God's anger bitterly
decisions.reason: The verb means to provoke to anger, and it is used for stirring up the LORD's anger by idolatry (1 Kings 16:33; Jeremiah 7:18). God is not named but is the one provoked.

decisions.choice: leave his blood on him: hold him guilty for the blood he has shed
alternatives: his own death will be on his own head
decisions.reason: "His blood is on him" is a legal phrase for a person who bears the guilt of a death (Leviticus 20:9). Ephraim's bloodshed (4:2; 6:8; 7:7) will not be taken away or forgiven; it stays on him.

decisions.choice: his Lord: God as Ephraim's master
decisions.reason: The word is not the divine name but the ordinary word for a master or lord. Ephraim belongs to God, and the chapter ends by naming the master Ephraim has insulted.

decisions.choice: his reproach: the contempt Ephraim has shown
decisions.reason: The scorn Ephraim has poured on God will come back on Ephraim himself. To "return" it is to repay, as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: provoked God (B); made God bitterly angry (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one provoked (m1). "His Lord" is capitalized as a title of God; "his" refers to Ephraim and takes no setting, while "he" for God in Literal does.

decisions.choice: "su Señor"
decisions.reason: Adon used of God is "Señor" in ordinary letters, not the divine name, as the English "Lord".

decisions.choice: "Bwana wake", capitalised, with no divine-name span
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here is *adon* ("his Lord"), not the divine name, so it is the plain title "Bwana" rather than BWANA.
